svg.title: Personal AI OS — start-project flow
svg.desc: The start-project capability creates the generic floor for bounded multi-session work: resolve the name first so an existing project is resumed rather than duplicated, create the folder under 10 Projects, create a schema-valid project note from the template with a minted id and stage, register it with aios generate, validate, and state where next actions go. Plans, handoffs, and gates belong to an installed method pack, which the capability mentions and consults but never rebuilds.
svg.text: start-project — a home, a valid note, a registration; the method is yours

g.text: resolve first — an existing project is resumed, not duplicated
the name in the user's own words
minted id · stage · goal · relations — schema-valid
aios generate · aios validate — visible to retrieval
## Next actions in the note · To-Do.md via manage-todo
Method pack installed? Consult it — by mention
plans · handoffs · gates are the pack's layer, never this floor's

svg.text: The floor never rebuilds anyone's method: no PLAN, no HANDOFF, no gates from this capability — ever.
